title: 倫敦泰晤士潮汐隧道~Thames Tideway Tunnel
focus: 合流溢流截流與隧道系統容量~Combined-sewer interception and tunnel capacity
summary: 從溢流口走到豎井、隧道與後端處理，學習為何截流、調蓄和抽送必須同時檢查；隧道本身不是污水淨化反應器。~Follow overflow interception through shafts, tunnel and downstream treatment, checking capture, storage and pumping together; the tunnel is not itself a purification reactor.

units.title: 合流區雨水入口：集水面積與逕流量~Combined-catchment storm entry: Catchment area and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「合流區雨水入口」觀察此因果關係。~Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at combined-catchment storm entry.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
units.verify: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「合流區雨水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for combined-catchment storm entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總雨量相同就保證尖峰淹水風險相同。~Equal storm totals guarantee equal peak flood risk.
units.practice: 先點選「合流區雨水入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the combined-catchment storm entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 溢流口尖峰歷線：尖峰流量與可用能力~Overflow peak hydrograph: Peak flow and available capacity
units.mechanism: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「溢流口尖峰歷線」觀察此因果關係。~Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Examine this relationship at overflow peak hydrograph.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：平均 Q=0.8 m³/s、假設尖峰係數 f=2.5。公式 Qp=fQ；代入 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s。適用邊界：係數為假設，不能代替地方降雨與下水道時序分析。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: mean Q=0.8 m³/s and assumed peak factor f=2.5. Formula Qp=fQ; substitution 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s. Boundary: The assumed factor does not replace local rainfall and sewer time-series analysis.
units.verify: 把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「溢流口尖峰歷線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for overflow peak hydrograph; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 平均流量通過即可證明暴雨時不溢流。~Passing mean flow proves that storm overflows cannot occur.
units.practice: 先點選「溢流口尖峰歷線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把尖峰係數改成3，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 m³/s。與基準 2 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the overflow peak hydrograph measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only the peak factor to3 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 m³/s. Compare with baseline 2 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 主隧道暫存：調蓄與連續方程~Main-tunnel storage: Storage and continuity
units.mechanism: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「主隧道暫存」觀察此因果關係。~Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at main-tunnel storage.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
units.verify: 以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「主隧道暫存」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for main-tunnel storage; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 最大容積等於每場雨都可用的容積。~Maximum volume equals the available volume for every storm.
units.practice: 先點選「主隧道暫存」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the main-tunnel storage measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 截流構造通水：流速與通水斷面~Interception flow section: Velocity and flow area
units.mechanism: 連續方程 Q=Av 將流量連到平均流速；局部收縮與阻塞提高流速及水頭損失。本單元在「截流構造通水」觀察此因果關係。~Continuity Q=Av links discharge to mean velocity; local contraction and blockage increase velocity and head loss. Examine this relationship at interception flow section.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量 Q=0.9 m³/s、有效面積 A=0.6 m²。公式 v=Q/A；代入 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻平均流；不能用平均流速判定局部沖刷或人員安全。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: flow Q=0.9 m³/s and clear area A=0.6 m². Formula v=Q/A; substitution 0.9/0.6 = 1.5 m/s. Boundary: Uniform mean flow; local scour or human safety cannot be inferred from mean velocity alone.
units.verify: 比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「截流構造通水」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for interception flow section; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 阻塞不會改變同一流量下的流速。~Blockage cannot change velocity at the same flow.
units.practice: 先點選「截流構造通水」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效面積減至0.45 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m/s。與基準 1.5 m/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the interception flow section measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only clear area to0.45 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m/s. Compare with baseline 1.5 m/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 隧道重力輸送：重力輸送與粗糙度~Gravity tunnel conveyance: Gravity conveyance and roughness
units.mechanism: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「隧道重力輸送」觀察此因果關係。~The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at gravity tunnel conveyance.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
units.verify: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「隧道重力輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for gravity tunnel conveyance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 同一斷面輸送能力與粗糙度無關。~Capacity of the same section is independent of roughness.
units.practice: 先點選「隧道重力輸送」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the gravity tunnel conveyance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 污水滯留時間：水力停留時間~Sewage residence time: Hydraulic retention time
units.mechanism: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「污水滯留時間」觀察此因果關係。~Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at sewage residence time.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
units.verify: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「污水滯留時間」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for sewage residence time; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。~V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
units.practice: 先點選「污水滯留時間」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the sewage residence time measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 雨後抽送恢復容量：提升水頭與電力~Post-storm pumping recovery: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「雨後抽送恢復容量」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at post-storm pumping recovery.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「雨後抽送恢復容量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for post-storm pumping recovery; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「雨後抽送恢復容量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the post-storm pumping recovery measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 送往處理廠污染帳：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Load delivered to treatment: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「送往處理廠污染帳」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at load delivered to treatment.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「送往處理廠污染帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for load delivered to treatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「送往處理廠污染帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the load delivered to treatment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 沿線液位同步：感測器偏移校正~Distributed level synchronization: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「沿線液位同步」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at distributed level synchronization.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「沿線液位同步」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for distributed level synchronization; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「沿線液位同步」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the distributed level synchronization measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 截流系統備援：備援與共同失效~Interception-system redundancy: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「截流系統備援」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at interception-system redundancy.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「截流系統備援」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for interception-system redundancy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「截流系統備援」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the interception-system redundancy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: Tideway公開資訊指出新隧道連接既有Lee Tunnel與污水處理網路，豎井將截流污水帶入主隧道。~Tideway describes connection to the existing Lee Tunnel and sewer-treatment network, with shafts channeling intercepted flows into the main tunnel.
